name: Adam Huntsman
bio: a Representative from Tennessee; born in Charlotte County, Va., February 11, 1786; moved to Jackson, Tenn.; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-fourth Congress (March 4, 1835-March 3, 1837); unsuccessful candidate for reelection in 1836 to the Twenty-fifth Congress; died August 23, 1849; interment in Old Salem Cemetery, Madison County, Tenn.
